title: Contact Form
description: Accessible government contact form: labeled inputs, message field with character limit, error summary, and submit button.

components.reason: Provides the form context every input requires (see coordination.prerequisites)

components.label: Full name
components.reason: Name field; instantiate once per additional text field (email, phone)

components.label: Topic
components.reason: Routes the message; swap for combo-box when there are more than 7 options

components.label: Message
components.reason: Message body with visible character limit

components.label: Error summary
components.reason: Page-level error summary rendered when validation fails

nesting: Components 2-4 are children of component 1; component 5 is the last child of component 1; component 6 sits above component 1 at page level
validationOrder: Message is required and within character limit
Email format valid (when an email field is instantiated)
a11yNotes: Link each error message to its input with aria-describedby
Move focus to the validation summary when submission fails
Associate every label with its input via matching for/id attributes
agentPromptSequence: 1. Fetch the form tile (order 1) and place it as the root container
2. Fetch input tiles (orders 2-4); instantiate text-input once per field needed
3. Fetch the button tile and place it as the last child of the form
4. On validation failure, render the validation summary above the form and link each error to its input id
